description: Drive a budget balance below zero
sql: UPDATE accounts SET balance_micro = -1 WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM accounts WHERE type = 'agent' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1)

description: Raise a budget above its cap
sql: UPDATE accounts SET balance_micro = cap_micro + 1 WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM accounts WHERE type = 'agent' AND cap_micro IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT 1)
UPDATE entries SET amount_micro = 0 WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM entries ORDER BY id LIMIT 1)
DELETE FROM entries WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM entries ORDER BY id LIMIT 1)
CREATE TABLE stub_proof_probe (id INT PRIMARY KEY)
